network.scope: No runtime script performs network I/O.

file_read.scope: The explicitly selected target plus bundled Skill assets.

file_write.scope: Target-relative reports requested through --output; manifest-managed style assets after explicit --apply; and canonical token CSS/TypeScript regeneration inside the explicitly selected Skill directory after --write.
file_write.reason: Inspection and verification need optional local reports; the installer needs bounded, user-authorized lifecycle writes.
controls: absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected
locally drifted managed files require explicit --force
no package manifest or dependency mutation

target_enforcement.openai: Runtime metadata declares explicit-only writes; CLI resolvers enforce target containment and explicit --apply/--write.
target_enforcement.claude: Adapter metadata mirrors explicit-only writes; CLI resolvers enforce target containment and explicit --apply/--write.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission policy ships with the neutral Skill; CLI resolvers enforce target containment and explicit --apply/--write.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus adapter metadata; CLI resolvers enforce target containment and explicit --apply/--write.
